subject: Symphony Labs — commercial cadence, lead registration & revenue split
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@symphonylabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Leone <marco.leone@symphonylabs.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership commercial terms — initial term sheet attached

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our product team and platform folks are excited about the integration surface. We attached a one-page term sheet to get alignment on how we’d structure referrals and resale. High-level asks from Symphony Labs: a 60/40 rev-share on first year ARR for deals we introduce and take to contract, a 12-month lead registration window, and a joint customer success trial credit (one 30-day free runway) for early adopters.

Two quick operational notes:
- We prefer single-touch lead registration (we’ll submit the form + evidence and expect confirmation within 3 business days).
- For resales where Symphony invoices directly, we’d request a remittance schedule in the partner ledger.

Attached: Symphony_Partner_TermSheet_v1.pdf and Symphony_Technical_Onboarding.xlsx

Can you confirm if those high-level commercial terms are workable and who on your side should own commercialization ops?

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships
Symphony Labs

--
Attachment: Symphony_Partner_TermSheet_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)
Attachment: Symphony_Technical_Onboarding.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 18 KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@symphonylabs.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial terms — initial term sheet attached

Hi Priya — great to see this in writing and appreciate the clarity. Camila (partner ops) and Ben (rev ops) are looped to run the playbook details. Initial thoughts:

1) Revenue split: 60/40 on first-year ARR to the quoted close sounds reasonable as an early-launch incentive, but we typically do a performance escrow for the first 12 months to protect channel integrity. Proposal: 60/40 first-year, transition to a 70/30 (Redwood/Symphony) on renewals if Symphony-led renewal motion < 30% assistance from Redwood.

2) Lead registration: 12-month window ok; we require evidence of first-touch (email thread + MQL id) and we guarantee registration confirmation within 2 business days. We’ll also add a 30-day grace period for stale leads where follow-up is in flight.

3) Resale invoicing: If Symphony invoices directly we’ll need net-30 remittance terms and a monthly partner ledger export. Ben — can you confirm feasibility?

4) Trial credits: happy to provide the 30-day trial credit for up to 5 named early-adopter customers during a 90-day launch window. We’ll want a joint success plan (Camila to own).

Next steps: I’ll have Ben circulate a short commercial term confirmation and Camila will send the lead-registration template + intake checklist. If that looks good we can move to MSA redlines and a short pilot SOW.

Thanks — Vanessa
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
[Vanessa Ortiz signature]

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial terms — next steps & ops checklist

Hi Priya — thanks, this is clear and actionable. From an ops standpoint I’m proposing the following lightweight playbook to avoid confusion during launch:

- Lead registration flow: Symphony submits intake form + first-touch email + qualifying notes into our partner portal. Redwood confirms registration within 48 hours and issues a registration ID.
- Validation: For contested registrations we’ll kick off a 10-business-day validation with both reps included; if unresolved it escalates to partner ops for arbitration.
- Commission tiers: we’ll implement the 60/40 first-year default, with a bonus multiplier for >$250k ACV deals (additional +5% to Symphony).
- Demo credits & trials: Camila will own a 5-customer trial pool for the first 90 days; we’ll track utilization via a shared Google Sheet.

I attached the intake checklist and suggested onboarding timeline. Please review and flag any legal/finance constraints.

Thanks,
Camila
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Redwood_Partner_Intake_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 6 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed MSA redlines + accounting notes

Forwarding initial redlines from finance/legal intake. Key points for our negotiation:

- Payment terms: net-30 is fine, but we need a clause for partner clawback in the event of chargebacks or customer credit adjustments within 90 days.
- Reporting cadence: monthly partner ledger, with CSV export and a reconciliation window of 45 days.
- Taxes and withholding: Symphony is responsible for local taxes where applicable; Redwood will gross-up commissions where required.

I’ve attached the proposed redlines (Redwood_Proposed_MSA_redlines.docx). Once legal signs off we should circulate to Symphony with a marked copy.

Ben
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Symphony Labs — commercial cadence, lead registration & revenue split

Priya — thanks for the fast turnaround and for sharing the term sheet. Summary and next steps:

- Commercials: Redwood confirms 60/40 first-year rev-share, performance-based renewal transition to 70/30 as discussed.
- Lead registration: Redwood to confirm registrations within 48 hours; 12-month window + 30-day grace for stale leads.
- Trials: Redwood provides up to 5 trial credits for a 90-day launch window.
- Finance/legal: Ben to share redlines and our proposed clawback/reconciliation language.

Please review the attached MSA redlines and, if acceptable, we’ll send a single DocuSign for (a) Term Sheet confirmation and (b) MSA mark-up acceptance. We’ve uploaded a shared folder for joint onboarding and a short HubSpot deal has been created to track progress.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSymphony-Partner-Onboarding

If that timeline works, let’s aim to have signed commercial terms + MSA executed by 2027-08-22 so we can start a pilot by the end of the month.

Thanks everyone — Vanessa
